item.title: Germany's far-right poised for power in state election
item.description: Germany's AfD's TikTok-fueled rise in Saxony-Anhalt is raising fears the country could see its first far-right governor since World War II.

item.title: Russia intensifies attacks on Ukraine's capital
item.description: In Ukraine, a week of near-continuous Russian attacks is upending the lives of residents in Kyiv and its suburbs.

item.title: Argentina's Milei escalates Falklands dispute, seizing on Trump comments and oil tensions
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei is escalating a dispute with Britain over the Falkland Islands with tougher sanctions targeting companies involved in a major offshore oil project

item.title: 2 trapped workers rescued from a hydropower tunnel 9 days after Nepal floods
item.description: Officials say rescuers in Nepal have pulled two workers alive from a tunnel Friday during an ongoing operation. The rescues come nine days after the Aug. 26 floods.

item.title: Nepali community in Texas grieves and prays for healing after flash floods
item.description: Nepalese groups in North Texas, which has one of the largest communities of people from Nepal in the U.S., continue to grieve the loss of hundreds of people after the devastating floods in August.

item.title: China's Xi visits Egypt for the first time in a decade
item.description: Xi Jinping's visit to Egypt for the first time in a decade, and during the Iran war, comes as U.S. allies broaden their security ties.

item.title: Critics question legality of Venezuela oil deals
item.description: Chevron's $7 billion Venezuela bet deepens U.S. ties to the country's oil industry. Critics say the deal poses risks to democracy and could fuel discontent over Washington's embrace of the government.

item.title: U.S.-Israel relations are on the rocks ahead of elections
item.description: Relations between the Trump administration and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu have turned rocky since Trump called a truce with Iran. Trump seeks progress in Gaza, but Netanyahu is taking a defiant stance ahead of an election.
